title: Prophecies of the Messiah
subtitle: Seventy major Old Testament prophecies, and the New Testament books that record their fulfillment.
hint: Hover a curve or a book to read the summary and the King James text. Click, or tap on a phone, to keep the full passage open below the chart. Tap the background to clear.
kicker: Old Testament prediction  ·  New Testament fulfillment
dotsNote: Each dot is one entry. Curves connect that Old Testament book to every New Testament book cited as a fulfillment. Color matches the fulfillment book. Select a book in the legend to show only those curves, and select it again to show all.
footnote: One entry — “The Messiah will return to preside over Judgment Day” (Psalm 110) — cites Daniel 7 and 12 for a future fulfillment rather than a New Testament book. Select Psalms to read it. No curve is drawn for that entry.
